insights.summary: Sky Gold closed FY26 at ₹6,295 Cr revenue (+77%) and reiterated ₹8,100 Cr for FY27, with Q4 already running at ₹7,650 Cr a year. New long-term targets: ₹18,000–19,000 Cr revenue, ₹945 Cr PAT and zero net debt by FY30, with net debt to halve in FY27. Management stopped giving volume guidance, citing gold-price volatility.

what_changed.text: Volume guidance dropped; only PAT and revenue targets from now on, because gold prices move revenue.
FY30 targets: ₹18,000–19,000 Cr revenue, ₹945 Cr PAT, 5.25% PAT margin, nil net debt.
Net debt to fall by more than 50% in FY27, helped by a land sale expected by August–September.
Promoters move to zero salary from FY27; rewards only through dividends paid from operating cash flow.
Akash Talesara proposed as CEO; MSKA (BDO network) appointed statutory auditor.

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: As a management team, we only provide achievable targets, and we routinely outperform them.

analyst_questions.topic: Customs duty hike and the PM's appeal to cut gold buying
analyst_questions.answer: No softening seen at B2B level yet; lightweight jewellery and exchange schemes help.
Zero GML used now because local gold is cheaper; ₹170 Cr facility sanctioned but undrawn.
About 650 kg a month in Q4 on 1.2 t capacity (~55% used); enough until March 2028.
Back to 22–23 days in 4 to 6 quarters as advance gold and exports grow.
Run-rate fell to 7–8% from 11%; expected back to 12% within a quarter.

red_flags.text: Operating cash flow was still negative at ₹45 Cr for FY26.
Volume guidance withdrawn, so revenue growth can no longer be split into volume and gold price.
Inventory was higher at year-end; management blamed Akshaya Tritiya deliveries slipping into April.
Exports dropped to a 7–8% run-rate from 11% after the Middle East disruption.

watch_next: Q1 FY27 revenue against the ₹8,100 Cr pace
Net debt falling towards half of the FY26 level

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Lightweight gold jewellery for retailers: casting, 22K plus 18K/14K/9K and diamond-studded pieces; growing 'advance gold' job-work model
business_snapshot.customers: Large chains including Reliance Jewels, CaratLane, Malabar, Kalyan, Senco, Titan, Joyalukkas, Thangamayil, Lalithaa
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: About 88% domestic, 12% exports (FY26); advance gold 11.5% of FY26 volume
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Weddings and festivals, shift from unorganised to organised jewellers, demand for lighter and lower-karat jewellery
